children: CONCLUDES NEGOTIATIONS ON PERMANENT CLOSURE OF VEITSILUOTO SAWMILL
SAWMILL PRODUCTION IN NORTHERN FINLAND WILL BE CENTRALISED FROM VEITSILUOTO TO COMPANY'S OTHER SAWMILLS
AS A RESULT OF DECISION, ABOUT 60 PEOPLE WILL BE MADE REDUNDANT
PRODUCTION AT VEITSILUOTO SAWMILL HAS BEEN CURTAILED TEMPORARILY SINCE EARLY AUGUST, AND PRODUCTION WILL NOW BE DISCONTINUED PERMANENTLY
